load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch checkpoint state dict from a given file path on disk
save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model state dict to a checkpoint file on disk
resolve_checkpoint_path: resolve a dora signature or file path into an existing checkpoint file path
flush_stale_checkpoints: remove old epoch checkpoints keeping only the last N most recent ones
checkpoint_name: generate a formatted checkpoint filename with optional name suffix and FSDP rank
